rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something current, recent, or the latest.

example.english: The software on this phone is up-to-date.
example.traditional: 呢部手機嘅軟件係最新嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 jyun5 gin6 hai6 zeoi3 san1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a person who is well-informed about news or developments.

example.english: They are up-to-date on the news because they work as a journalist.
example.traditional: 佢做記者，所以消息靈通。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 gei3 ze2 so2 ji5 siu1 sik1 ling4 tung1
